column1: # Morphology and colour of the 15 galaxies of Di Teodoro et al. 2023 (arXiv:2207.02906), compiled 2026-09-28 by a delegated reader from small catalogue row queries:
# T = RC3 numerical Hubble type (de Vaucouleurs et al. 1991; VizieR VII/155; 'nan' where RC3 has none); W2W3 = AllWISE W2-W3 colour (IRSA; 'nan' = not obtained).
# The paper itself calls only UGC12591 lenticular ('S0/Sa'), 'an extremely massive, lenticular galaxy with relatively little gas'.  NOT independently re-verified.
# CFG41's headline colour assignment is CFG36's convention on T (T <= 0 red, T >= 1 blue; no T -> blue); the WISE assignment (W2-W3 < 2.0 red) is a reported sensitivity.
